reviewScope.excluded: All profile-local readme directives (including Bookings/v1.0/readme.md and Bookings/beta/readme.md) and src/readme.graph.md are explicitly ignored.
reviewScope.deferred: Parameter aliases/transforms and schema/response directives remain deferred; none occur in the three shared groups.
reviewScope.naming: Retain the existing Solution-prefix strip and BackupRestore exception; do not add redundant overrides. The baseline generator uses Mg for both profiles; beta prefix-only parity differences are outside this migration.

mappings.notes: Reviewed expected absence: the literal singular solution selector matches no operation IDs in either compatible spec. Actual GET/PATCH /solutions IDs use plural solutions.solutionsRoot and are recorded separately in compatibilityOperations. Retain the existing exact-path suppression for SDK compatibility, without claiming these are literal-selector matches.

Existing exact /solutions/virtualEvents suppression covers GET, PATCH (including expanded parameter forms), and DELETE in both profiles. Do not suppress child events, webinars, townhalls, or unrelated booking operations.

Existing StripNounPrefix already removes Solution from every /solutions/ child noun. Enumerate the full reviewed method/path/operation-ID set, including suppressed virtualEvents root operations. BackupRestore is absent from these specs; preserve and independently pin its existing exception rather than extending this rename. Beta top-level /bookingBusinesses and /bookingCurrencies routes are outside this selector and remain unchanged.
